purpose: Offline demo data for tickers added after the original data/ pack. Consulted only when a ticker is absent from data/.

provenance.prices: SIMULATED daily paths (market/sector/FX factor model) pinned to anchors. Nov-2024, Nov-2025 and 09-Nov-2026 anchors are actual NSE closes (split/bonus adjusted); earlier anchors are approximate. ETERNAL starts at its Jul-2021 listing and NYKAA at its Nov-2021 listing.
provenance.fundamentals: Approximate, rounded annual figures in the yfinance statement layout for demo use; secondary lines derived from sector ratios. Not audited.
provenance.refresh: `python data_loader.py --refresh` writes live data for every ticker into data/, after which this folder is no longer consulted.
